slots.name: protest attendance
slots.sentence: Standing near the back in a packed Salisbury, Maryland, church was a Haitian immigrant mother named Venue, joining around 100 of her community members in calling for changes to immigration enforcement in Maryland.

slots.name: green card years
slots.sentence: It took Raymond around 15 years to get his green card -- now working as an immigration lawyer in Salisbury.
